deliberate_reference_differences.binary_cursor: The owned binary-file API treats its current cursor as the logical start. Pinned PyAV can seek to absolute offsets of a prefixed underlying file and read header bytes as PCM; that nonzero-cursor prefix bug is not reproduced.

he_aac_cpu_profiles.reference: Original FFmpeg8.1.2 GENERIC codec and SWR (av_force_cpu_flags(0)); same original source-order float32 AVTX split-radix operation graph.

deliberate_reference_differences.ogg_chaining_and_silence: RFC link reset and silent-channel mapping are checked with the independent native libopus multistream oracle. FFmpeg8.1.2 internal Opus preserves old decoder history on the tested new logical link and its silent-map out-buffer assignment can overwrite the active buffer; those source behaviors are not imitated.
deliberate_reference_differences.opus_decoder: Pinned PyAV defaults to the separate FFmpeg float Opus/SILK decoder. This port uses the authorized existing libopus1.3.1 codec, whose SILK fixed-point synthesis/upsampling is a different valid RFC6716 decoding implementation. The independent libopus oracle passes max1LSB, but it is not claimed bit equivalent to FFmpeg internal SILK.
deliberate_reference_differences.real_speech_comparison_scope: Actual two-second JFK speech, original Faster-Whisper decoder/orchestration and trained tiny.en model vs owned libopus1.3.1 audio + stdlib frontend/orchestration through actual same CT2. Words/tokens/times match; confidence metrics differ and are not claimed equivalent.

real_speech_comparisons.text: And so am I fellow America.

deliberate_reference_differences.rifx: As pinned wavdec actually does, header integer byte order is big endian while its WAVE codec table selects little-endian PCM/float payload decoding.

interfaces.decode_audio: decode_audio(path_or_binary_file,sampling_rate=16000,split_stereo=False) -> array(f) or (left array(f),right array(f)); normalized PCM values are signed_s16/32768. Caller-owned binary files remain open and read from their current cursor.

interfaces.resampling: FFmpeg8.1.2 default SWR Kaiser beta9/filter_size32/cutoff.97/phase_shift10/exact rational; filter length scales with downsampling ratio. Source format controls S16/float32/float64 internal processing. Original rematrix coefficients, integer quantization/cast behavior, rematrix-vs-resample order, initial/final reflection and flush length are retained. The original 22.2 layout special case compacts its selected first nine channels before matrix construction; all 868 AAC file/rate/downmix results match independent original s16 output within one LSB.

limits: Additional compressed containers/codecs and network protocols from PyAV are not implemented by this slice. Opus projection/ambisonic mappings, AAC Main/LD/USAC, encrypted MP4 and other unported codecs fail explicitly.
Damaged Ogg CRC/sequence/continuation is rejected explicitly instead of implementing every FFmpeg damaged-stream recapture heuristic.

Finite normalized float PCM is verified through amplitudes1.25 and filter overshoot. Native SIMD/scalar integer conversion of NaN/Inf or values outside representable integer ranges has architecture/frame-boundary-dependent results; such non-audio overflow is not claimed bit equivalent.
The existing frontend one-hour decoded waveform bound remains; no external program, native codec or hosted transcription fallback is introduced.

HE-AAC/SBR/PS uses the original FFmpeg GENERIC CPU profile. All1,444 original file/SWR comparisons pass within1LSB, while the independently retained optimized host profile differs by up to58LSB on stress inputs. Generic agreement is not universal CPU-bit equivalence.

Vorbis corrupt AUDIO packet handling and original generator termination with retained partial PCM have separate pending qualification; the proven decoder-init filter applies only after successful original demux/duration-header validation.

native_authoring_only.file_consumer: Original transcribe.py and actual trained tiny.en/CT2v4.8.1 model decode real file paths, independently compared with candidate audio/frontend/orchestration through the same real native engine. Production always selects the qualified pure Whisper engine; full stdlib inference E2E is recorded separately in local-whisper-segments-provenance.json.
native_authoring_only.oracle: Original faster-whisper1.2.1 audio.py with actual pinned PyAV18.1.0/FFmpeg8.1.2. Ogg Opus codec-independent PCM is additionally verified by actual native libopus1.3.1 multistream decoder, original PyAV demux, then original SWR. Only ignored cache contains native wheels, source archives and authoring shared objects; no native library/process/download is used in runtime or public tests.
